newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Heska Corp files IPO with SEC.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Heska Corp files IPO with SEC.

text.p: Heska Corp filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer common shares to the public for the first time.
The Fort Collins, Colo., manufacturer of animal health products did not disclose how many shares will be offered or at what price.
Underwriters for the offering are Credit Suisse First Boston and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc.
Proceeds will be used to finance research and development, to expand sales and marketing and for other corporate needs.
In 1996, the company reported revenue of $9.9 million, up from revenue of $2.2 million the year earlier.
